proof_decision.trust_question: Does trusted proof execution reject missing, unsupported, or host-mismatched shell semantics before launch and bind selection, receipt, and resume identity to the declared dialect, while the repo evidence strategy remains schema-constrained?
proof_decision.narrowest_evidence: The existing trusted-execution rejection test is now one parameterized behavior-class matrix covering admission, source, missing dialect, unsupported dialect, and host mismatch. Existing shell-semantics and selected-proof receipt/reuse tests carry dialect identity assertions. Existing repo-evidence-strategy tests now validate applicable and quiet producer output against the typed schema, reject malformed and unknown fields, and prove decision identity sensitivity.
proof_decision.prune_or_replacement_condition: Convert the deterministic dialect admission and evidence-strategy schema cases to contract-owned conformance only when the canonical operation contract can run them across supported Python and generated targets; retain one representative selected-proof black-box receipt/resume path.
proof_decision.residual_risk: Hosted CI remains the cross-host proof for POSIX execution; local Windows coverage proves PowerShell invocation and rejects a POSIX dialect before launch without emulating another host.
